sources.label: Federal Reserve H10 weekly release rule
Chicago Fed NFCI Wednesday release schedule

assumptions.tx_twse_end_of_day_signals: lag 0 means signal computed after t close; earliest hypothetical action is t+1, not t close
assumptions.h10_10_calendar_day_lag: Conservative observation-date cutoff, NOT an exact US holiday-aware published vintage
assumptions.sample_overlap: Five- and 20-session forward outcome windows overlap unless explicitly selected on nonoverlap grid
assumptions.quarter_segments: Holdout spans mainly 2026; quarter diagnostics are not multi-cycle generalization
assumptions.transaction_costs: not applicable to this warning-only diagnostic; no executable trading strategy
assumptions.release_time_source_verification: pending ALFRED probe plus primary release timestamp review

FRED source observation date is not a publication date.
FRED historical vintage as-of date can differ from latest downloaded history.
Approximate bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not formal model certification.
